note: P1 transitions: fixed defects keep their baseline signature as evidence and gain real regression tests that must pass. open defects still reproduce their exact baseline signature; unexpected success there is still XPASS/failure. A green suite is not a product PASS.

status_rules.fixed: defect fixed in this candidate; every listed regression test must pass
status_rules.open: baseline defect still reproduces its exact signature
status_rules.not_applicable: defect lives on a code path absent from main
status_rules.deferred: applies to main but reproduction needs assets/environments outside this suite

defects.title: Locale-dependent text I/O (implicit encoding)
defects.baseline_signature: deployed scripts contain read_text()/write_text() calls without encoding= (e.g. gg_core.py canonical load, gg_finance.py manifest write)
defects.fix: explicit encoding="utf-8" on all text file I/O (read_text/write_text/open/fdopen) across deployed scripts; subprocess text pipes pinned to utf-8

defects.title: Non-string record id corrupts canonical
defects.baseline_signature: apply() accepts {'id': 7}, writes canonical, reload raises ValueError 'ID/개정번호 오류: 7'; canonical bytes changed
defects.fix: gg_core._check_record_id rejects non-string, blank, edge-whitespace and control-character IDs before any store; covers create and modify paths (all ops funnel through apply)

defects.title: Stale .gg-lock blocks all writes; no recovery command
defects.baseline_signature: pre-existing .gg-lock dir makes apply() raise '쓰기 잠금 존재' and gg.py exposes no unlock/recovery command
defects.fix: v2 guard/capability lock protocol (.gg-lock persistent dir); stale owner record cleanup via gg.py unlock (gg_lock.cleanup_owner); explicit offline upgrade via lock-upgrade (upgrade_offline); live guard still excludes a second writer

defects.title: No Python >=3.10 entry guard
defects.baseline_signature: gg.py contains no sys.version_info floor; on 3.9 commands run instead of a clean pre-reject
defects.fix: gg.py main() rejects Python<3.10 with a blocked JSON message and exit 2 before argparse, side effects, and the gg_core import (core import moved inside main); module import alone stays side-effect free. No installed 3.9 on this machine — verified via version_info shim + poisoned-import band; real 3.9 not run

defects.title: Windows Office automation quits user's existing instance
defects.baseline_signature: gg_office_win.py calls gencache.EnsureDispatch then unconditional Quit(); no pre-dispatch block
defects.fix: gg_office_win.WINDOWS_COM_BLOCKED + run_word/run_excel _fail(code=2) before import pythoncom; gg_office.run_windows_com returns rc=2 without spawning; dormant EnsureDispatch/Quit retained below the guard pending native verification

defects.title: Merged-cell markers '<'/'^' counted as filled
defects.fix: gg_document._filled_cell treats '<'/'^' merge markers as empty; valid values preserved

defects.title: Wide tables may rotate whole section to landscape
defects.baseline_signature: build_docx.py calls the table-layout helper without allow_landscape=False
defects.fix: build_docx.py calls fit_table with allow_landscape=False on the official path

defects.title: Unrendered nodes between TOC and body accepted silently
defects.baseline_signature: build_docx.py has no unrendered-node rejection (_unrendered raise)
defects.fix: build_docx.py raises ValueError on unrendered leftover nodes (official path)

defects.title: Missing wanted cells skipped silently in template blank-copy

defects.title: print_titles emits bare definedName without definedNames container

defects.fix: gg_excel_print.py emits a proper definedNames container with namespace/localSheetId

defects.fix: question() reuse set no longer includes 'unknown'; provided/explicit_none/not_applicable/withheld still reuse

defects.fix: gg_core._finance_check_items's eligible() now checks unit membership in gg_finance_body._MONETARY_UNITS ('원','천원') instead of a single '천원' string comparison; non-monetary units (ratio, kg, etc.) stay correctly excluded per R6-overblock's positive control
